title: Counting 1 to 5 — God's Blessings
memory_verse: "He counts the number of the stars." — Psalm 147:4
objective: Students will learn to count from 1 to 5 using objects God created.
content: Let's learn to count! God made numbers so we can count all His blessings. Ready? 1, 2, 3, 4, 5!
Hold up 1 finger. God made 1 sun! Hold up 2 fingers. God gave you 2 eyes! Hold up 3 fingers. Count 3 flowers!
Hold up 4 fingers. Count 4 legs on a dog! Hold up 5 fingers. Count all 5 fingers on one hand! God is so good to give us so many wonderful things to count.
activity: Count objects around the room. Put 1 to 5 blocks in a line and count them. Color the numbers 1 through 5.
discussion: How many eyes did God give you?
How many fingers are on one hand?
